name: Magic Circle
description: A magic circle that warps players to a specified location.

fields.name: Trigger Variable
fields.description: The local variable number that triggers or activates this actor.

fields.name: Destination Layer
fields.description: The layer to warp to, optionally with a transition effect.

1.name: Dark World
1.description: Warps to the Dark World layer, Slight Shaking, Pixelation, Music Distortion.

2.name: GBA Layer 2
2.description: Warps to the GBA 2 layer, Heavy Shaking.

3.name: GBA Layer 3
3.description: Warps to the GBA 3 layer,Slight Shaking.

fields.name: Arrival X Coordinate
fields.description: The X coordinate where players arrive after the warp.

fields.name: Arrival Y Coordinate
fields.description: The Y coordinate where players arrive after the warp.

fields.name: Magic Circle Type
fields.description: The type of magic circle effect.

0.name: Default
0.description: Can be used by all Links.

1.name: Green
1.description: Can only be used by green Link.

2.name: Red
2.description: Can only be used by red Link.

3.name: Blue
3.description: Can only be used by blue Link.

4.name: Purple
4.description: Can only be used by purple Link.

6.name: Beam up
6.description: The player spins around and flies up.

fields.name: Secret Sound Effect
fields.description: Plays the Zelda secret sound effect when the magic circle appears.

fields.name: Room Variable Mode
fields.description: Determines how the room variable controls the magic circle.

0.name: Always Active
0.description: The magic circle is always active.

1.name: Timed Variable
1.description: The magic circle repeatedly appears and disappears over time while the room variable is set.

2.name: Variable Controlled
2.description: The room variable directly controls whether the magic circle is active.

3.name: Inverted Variable Controlled
3.description: The magic circle is active when the room variable is off and inactive when it is on.

4.name: Delayed Activation
4.description: Uses a timer on the first activation, then allows the room variable to toggle the magic circle.

5.name: Timed Activation
5.description: The magic circle remains active for a limited time before becoming inactive.

6.name: Player Count: 1
6.description: Uses a player-count condition for one player.

7.name: Player Count: 2
7.description: Uses a player-count condition for two players.

8.name: Player Count: 3
8.description: Uses a player-count condition for three players.

9.name: Player Count: 4
9.description: Uses a player-count condition for four players.
